experiment.description: Staged hybrid embedding benchmark matrix with a frozen Keyword+LLM control, deterministic per-arm collection naming, and Stage1/Stage2A/Stage2B promotion rules.

stage1_dense_arms.label: Control: OpenAI 3-large + SPLADE + Keyword+LLM
stage1_dense_arms.rationale: Frozen parity-gate control arm from the shipped Keyword+LLM hybrid baseline.

stage1_dense_arms.label: Voyage 4-large + SPLADE + Keyword+LLM
stage1_dense_arms.rationale: Higher-quality low-cost dense challenger under the fixed SPLADE + Keyword+LLM control stack.

stage1_dense_arms.label: Voyage 4-lite + SPLADE + Keyword+LLM
stage1_dense_arms.rationale: Lower-latency dense challenger under the same sparse-side control.

stage1_dense_arms.label: BGE-M3 dense + SPLADE + Keyword+LLM
stage1_dense_arms.rationale: Open dense challenger that stays on the fixed SPLADE sparse control path.

stage2a_sparse_candidates.label: SPLADE control encoder
stage2a_sparse_candidates.rationale: Preserves the current production-relevant sparse encoder as the Stage 2A control.

stage2a_sparse_candidates.label: BGE-M3 sparse encoder
stage2a_sparse_candidates.rationale: Tests whether the BGE-M3 lexical output improves hybrid quality under the same Keyword+LLM sparse corpus.

stage2b_sparse_text_policies.label: Keyword+LLM control corpus
stage2b_sparse_text_policies.rationale: Keeps the current best-known sparse text treatment as the Stage 2B anchor.

stage2b_sparse_text_policies.label: Rule-only corpus
stage2b_sparse_text_policies.rationale: Uses the existing tool_name + description + parameter_names enrichment rule without LLM text.

stage2b_sparse_text_policies.label: Raw description degradation check
stage2b_sparse_text_policies.rationale: Measures the degradation when sparse text falls back to the original tool text only.
